caption: The drawing depicts a female figure standing upright and wearing a dress composed of multiple patterned fabrics. The figure has pale skin, black shoulder-length hair, and rosy cheeks, with a yellow and brown bonnet tied under her chin. The upper garment is a red dress with short puffed sleeves and a gathered bodice decorated with vertical lines and small white, circular or floral motifs, fastened at the neckline with a bow. Over the dress, she wears a white apron with small scattered purple or blue dots and a wide, brown and white checked collar that sits on her shoulders. The dress reaches down to her ankles, under which she wears white pants extending to the mid-calf, patterned with a subtle checkered design. Her feet are clad in yellow shoes with small bows. To the right of the figure, there is a vertical strip containing six fabric swatches showing various patterns and colors: brown and tan checked, white with small purple dots, red checkered, red with blue dots, brown with light blue dots, and purple checkered. The drawing is executed on a plain off-white background.
title: Pioneer Doll
